1. Member Benefits

Benefits Overview

Created by Dana Okafor, last modified on Mar 14, 2026

The Member Benefits handbook describes what the plan covers, who is eligible, and how to appeal a denied claim. It is not a substitute for the certificate of coverage.

What is covered

  • Preventive care at 100% when in network

  • Specialist visits after the deductible

    • A referral is required on some plans

    • Out-of-network specialists are covered at 60%

  • Emergency care, in network or out

Where to go next

  1. Read the Eligibility Rules

  2. Then the 2026 plan summary

  3. Ask the benefits desk if anything is unclear

The plan year runs 1 January to 31 December. Mid-year changes need a qualifying life event.

Questions about the handbook itself go to the #benefits channel.
